tools.name: search_faber_catalog
tools.description: Search the bounded Faber catalog for relevant Atom, Bundle, and engine products. Returns compact product cards; does not dump the full inventory.

tools.name: get_faber_product
tools.description: Get public machine-readable metadata for one Faber product by stable product ID, including price, version, scope and bundle composition when applicable.

tools.name: buy_faber_product
tools.description: Buy any currently active Faber catalog product by stable product ID. First call without paymentSignature returns the x402 challenge; retry with the signed PAYMENT-SIGNATURE.

tools.name: faber_solar_concept
tools.description: Produces concept-level solar, thermal, cooling, cleaning, and storage considerations from site conditions. Paid through FABER x402. Price: $0.02. Network: Base Mainnet (eip155:8453), currency: USDC.

tools.name: faber_desert_infrastructure
tools.description: Structures concept-level power, water, cooling, data-center, agriculture, and infrastructure options for arid sites. Paid through FABER x402. Price: $0.03. Network: Base Mainnet (eip155:8453), currency: USDC.

tools.name: faber_strategic_land
tools.description: Generates future-use scenarios and infrastructure questions for underused or undervalued land. Paid through FABER x402. Price: $0.03. Network: Base Mainnet (eip155:8453), currency: USDC.

tools.name: faber_lucas_recovery
tools.description: Structures concept-level recovery priorities for water, power, sanitation, communications, food, shelter, and logistics. Paid through FABER x402. Price: $0.03. Network: Base Mainnet (eip155:8453), currency: USDC.

tools.name: faber_scene_production
tools.description: Converts a scene into structured production information for location, characters, action, continuity, and camera planning. Paid through FABER x402. Price: $0.01. Network: Base Mainnet (eip155:8453), currency: USDC.

tools.name: faber_information_weight
tools.description: Research-derived information weighting engine; not presented as a calibrated probability. Paid through FABER x402. Price: $0.005. Network: Base Mainnet (eip155:8453), currency: USDC.

tools.name: faber_evidence_quality
tools.description: Scores evidence quality before another agent acts: source independence, duplication, contradiction, freshness, confidence basis, validity, and missing information. Paid through FABER x402. Price: $0.01. Network: Base Mainnet (eip155:8453), currency: USDC.

tools.name: faber_event_delta
tools.description: Compares previous and current evidence states and returns only machine-readable changes, removals, source changes, and confidence movement. Paid through FABER x402. Price: $0.005. Network: Base Mainnet (eip155:8453), currency: USDC.

tools.name: faber_evidence_bundle
tools.description: Packages evidence quality and information-order outputs into one compact structured bundle for downstream agent decision support. Paid through FABER x402. Price: $0.02. Network: Base Mainnet (eip155:8453), currency: USDC.

tools.name: faber_custom_assembly
tools.description: Builds a machine-readable information assembly for a buyer-specified event, target, geography, horizon, metric, and purpose. Paid through FABER x402. Price: $0.03. Network: Base Mainnet (eip155:8453), currency: USDC.
